split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's partner in the field, with feelings for him.

changes.evidence: The Hydro-Man pursuit is episode 59 (The Return of Hydro-Man, Part 1: 'With Black Cat's help, Spider-Man sets off in pursuit'), not 62. Episode 62 (The Gauntlet of the Red Skull) is where Spider-Man brings Black Cat to the planet, the team attacks the Red Skull's empire, and they share a kiss. The stage at #62 tells a #59 event, so the Hydro-Man part moves to its own #59 stage and the Battleworld part stays at #62.

now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#63
now.text: On the Beyonder's world, Alistair ends up aiding the heroes.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The hero Alistair blames for his father's loss.

changes.evidence: Alistair turns to help the heroes against the Red Skull and Doctor Octopus (Marvel Animated wiki: 'He later assists the heroes against the Red Skull and Doctor Octopus'). The Red Skull is defeated in episode 62, The Gauntlet of the Red Skull (episode 63 opens 'After defeating the Red Skull'), and the Marvel Database cites Smythe joining the heroes to Season 5 episodes 9-10 (Arrival and The Gauntlet of the Red Skull, app #61-#62). The help comes in #62, not #63 (Doom).

owner_calls.question: The pair's only stage is #46, but the Scorpion and the Vulture already meet in #27 (The Final Nightmare): they fight at Dr. Connors's lab, then agree to team up to cure their mutations. Add an earlier stage at #27?
options: Add an ally stage at Spider-Man (1994)#27: 'The Scorpion and the Vulture fight at Dr. Connors's lab, then agree to team up to cure their mutations.' and keep #46 as the enemy stage
owner_calls.evidence: Episode 27: 'After a brief fight, Scorpion and Vulture agree to team up to assist each other with their problems.' Then Connors leaves the Vulture with the mutation.
